subject: Procurement path & security gating — next steps for BrightPath POC
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement path & security gating — next steps for BrightPath POC

Hi Elena — great to meet you and Tom on today’s demo. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement and security gating for the POC:

- Summary of ask: 3-week POC, sample dataset (anonymized), want <50ms tail latency for interactive UI.
- Commercial path: you mentioned preference for a PO (invoice) if procurement can sign a short SOW vs. starting on card for a short pilot. We can support both — PO with standard net-30 or card for immediate start.
- Marketplace: you asked whether BrightPath can consume via AWS Marketplace — yes, Redwood is listed (we can switch to marketplace billing for production), but PO path is more typical for our enterprise POCs.
- Security gating: SOC 2 Attestation and our DPA are the two items procurement usually needs before issuing a PO. If you have a security questionnaire, we can either fill it or provide our security pack and an engineer to walk through answers.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll attach our SOC 2 attestation and the latest DPA draft for review.
2) If procurement prefers PO, Laura (cc’d) will send our commercial checklist and billing instructions — typical PO timeline is 7–14 business days if there are no extra contract redlines.
3) If you want faster time-to-demo, you can start on card today; we’ll convert to PO/marketplace once procurement completes.
4) If BrightPath has a security questionnaire, please send it over — we often need one week + security review time to complete answers and provide any evidence.

I’ve attached a short procurement checklist to speed things along. Happy to jump on a follow-up call with procurement/security next week. Please let me know which route you prefer (PO vs card vs marketplace) and any deadlines on your side.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189

Attachments:
- redwood_soc2_cert_2024.pdf (SOC 2 Type II attestation stub)
- Redwood_DPA_2026-03.pdf (draft DPA)
- redwood_procurement_checklist.xlsx (attachment)

Thanks Jasmine — great demo. A couple quick notes from procurement/security here:

- Procurement preference: PO is preferred. Our procurement lead requires signed DPA + SOC 2 report before issuing PO.
- Marketplace: nice to have for long-term billing but procurement will still want the DPA + attestation.
- Security questionnaire: we have a short vendor security form (attached) — can you confirm whether you prefer us to send it directly or you want to route it via your security ops?

Timeline: we’d like to kick off the POC the week of 4/12 — is that feasible if PO process starts early next week?

Elena

elena@brightpath.ai

Elena — thanks, timeline sounds reasonable. Quick answers inline + actions:

- DPA & SOC 2: uploading the SOC 2 stub and the DPA draft for your legal team (attached). If procurement needs any redlines, point us to the specific clauses and Laura will coordinate with legal.
- Security questionnaire: happy to take your vendor security form. You can either: (a) send it back to me and I’ll coordinate completion with our security ops (preferred), or (b) route it to security@redwood.com and cc me. For faster turnaround, option (a) usually works well — I’ll assign an eng + compliance contact on our side.
- PO vs card: to meet your 4/12 start, I recommend starting the internal demo on card this week to unblock the team, while procurement works PO in parallel — that avoids a hard dependency while documents finalize. We’ll switch billing to PO or marketplace afterward.

Action items I’m tracking: 
- Jasmine: share SOC 2 attestation + DPA draft (attached) — DONE.
- BrightPath: send vendor security questionnaire (if you want us to complete).
- Laura: send PO instructions & commercial checklist once BrightPath confirms they prefer PO.

I’ve attached the procurement checklist and a short checklist for security evidence requests to clarify dependencies. If you want a brief call between procurement and our billing team, I can set that up for Wed or Thu this week.

Best,

Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Jasmine — noted. Two internal items from finance/legal/security: 

1) Finance needs invoice billing contacts and a PO template from BrightPath — Jasmine, can you ask Elena to have procurement send a PO sample or their payment processing contact? That speeds net-30 setup.
2) Security asks that we assign a dedicated responder for the questionnaire — Karthik, can you be the internal point here? Approx. workload: 4–6 hours to answer the questionnaire + evidence collection (logs, controls matrix). If they push for SOC 2 artifact access beyond the attestation, we’ll need security ops to schedule an evidence drop (typical TAT 3 business days).

If BrightPath wants to start on card to hit 4/12, finance is fine — they just want the note in the deal that billing is converting from card -> PO later.

Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
